knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The exclusion has to be dealt with before the work is accepted, through scope change, written confirmation or referral. Assuming cover or buying on price alone does not address it.
Comparison is only fair when the scope, limits, exclusions and conditions are the same.
Insurance gives financial protection for claims that the policy covers. It does not give a licence, a payment guarantee or permission to work.

practicalCriteria: Learner produces an insurance register listing each policy with cover type, limit, excess, start date and renewal date.
Learner compares at least two quotes for the same scope, with exclusions recorded side by side.
Learner identifies one exclusion that affects the planned work and states the decision taken, with the reason.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Learner accepts a job that the policy excludes, without written confirmation or a referral.
